name: desire for food
description: Physical or mental desire to eat.

variations.name: actually hungry
variations.description: Hunger is an uncomfortably empty feeling in the belly driving you to seek nourishment.

variations.name: clock says hungry
variations.description: Often in the modern world, we're ready to eat mostly because the clock says it's time for a meal and you're ready for a break from work.

variations.name: grazing
variations.description: You can feel a desire for food by watching others eat. For example, watching an advertisement that shows happy people eating your favorite dish.

variations.name: comfort snacking
variations.description: Snacking can be driven by a deep desire for comfort brought about by the sensations and brain chemicals of the actual eating, and of having the economic luxury to do so.

commentaries.quote: It may be helpful to be aware of why you're heading to the refrigerator: boredom, anxiety, social bonding, or actual hunger.

conditions: Perception that sharing a bite with others will be a bonding experience.
Perception that eating may alleviate anxiety by providing comfort.
